comment: cfgfiles.c parse_conf_file() sections in a wizkit file: WIZKIT=.nethackrc rereads a CHOOSE=first,second line, so choose_random_part() draws rn2(2) once in initoptions() and again in read_wizkit(); only the chosen section's item line reaches proc_wizkit_line(), and "[]" ends the sections. Seed, date, Samurai and items chosen independently.

segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Chooser,role:Samurai,race:human,gender:male,align:lawful,playmode:debug,!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,pettype:none,!autopickup
WIZKIT=.nethackrc
CHOOSE=first,second
[first]
3 cream pies
[second]
blessed +1 elven mithril-coat
[]
